Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning remedies for improper challenges to a voter's registration.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to remedies for improper challenges to a voter'sregistration; adding a new section to chapter 29A.08 RCW; andprescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 29A.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The canvassing board may issue notice of a class 1 civilinfraction under chapter 7.80 RCW to any person challenging theregistration of another if the canvassing board determines that thechallenger: (a) Failed to exercise reasonable diligence in determiningthe accuracy of the allegations on which the challenge is based; (b)failed to base the challenge on his or her personal knowledge; (c) whoin issuing the challenge, primarily considered the voter's politicalbelief, political activity, or any characteristic protected by the lawagainst discrimination under chapter 49.60 RCW; or (d) issued achallenge in bad faith or in an effort to intimidate, harass, orotherwise deter a properly registered voter from voting. (2) A voter whose registration has been challenged by another p. 1 SSB 6134registered voter is entitled to recover from the challenging voteractual attorneys' fees incurred in opposing the challenge if thechallenge is rejected by the canvassing board or county auditor.
